confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors are supported by San Juan aggregated cost-of-living prices; cocktail and wine evidence is thinner, and lodging anchors are holistic estimates without live listings. The wine estimate uses local menu examples around $8–12 and a roughly three-times-draft-beer relationship.
comparable_city_reasoning: Use the U.S. dollar market and U.S. coastal tourist-city cost levels, adjusted for San Juan's Caribbean tourism and island supply context; local San Juan price data anchors food and drink.
